implementation.targetScope: State 1.4.4 editor state, transactions, text/node/all selections, bookmarks and plugin lifecycle; real Tiptap 2.11.7 commands and application-shaped link, trailing-node and selection plugins with current/app model and transform controls. Browser view implementation, IME, full application integration and collaborative transport acceptance are separate.

changes: Independent state and transaction implementation, with precomputed plugin field and append-hook lists.
Selection JSON positions require nonnegative safe integers; selection registration and transaction metadata do not inherit object prototype names. Plugin props use own keys.
Two VPM runtime dependencies: vprosemirror-model 1.25.12 and vprosemirror-transform 1.12.5. No upstream runtime source shipped.
Optional prosemirror-view peer supplies consumer view types only. EditorView remains outside this implementation.
